title: Implement dry-run preview pipeline for premium Excel import
description: Build a dry-run/preview pipeline that parses the Excel file, validates all rows, resolves employee identities, detects duplicates and conflicts, and returns a detailed preview summary without writing to the database. Follows ptkpExcelDryRunService pattern: parse, validate each row against DB, classify actions, build summary breakdown.

files.change: Add new function dryRunPremiumExcel() that parses all rows using column mapping from TASK-001, validates each row (empcode exists in DB, premium type valid, amounts non-zero), checks for existing records in payroll_manual_adjustments, classifies each row as READY_INSERT/WOULD_UPDATE/DUPLICATE/ERROR, and returns PremiumDryRunResult with row-by-row breakdown.
Add PremiumDryRunRow, PremiumDryRunSummary, PremiumDryRunAction types. PremiumDryRunSummary includes total_rows, total_amount, action_breakdown by type, errors list.

implementation: Define PremiumDryRunAction enum: READY_INSERT, WOULD_UPDATE, DUPLICATE_SAME, DUPLICATE_DIFFERENT, SKIP_INVALID_EMPCODE, SKIP_INVALID_PREMIUM_TYPE, SKIP_ZERO_AMOUNT
Define PremiumDryRunRow: empcode, premium_type, gang_code, amount, item_count, existing_id, existing_amount, action, reason
Define PremiumDryRunSummary: dry_run (true), total_rows, total_amount, action_breakdown (count per action), errors[]

Implement dryRunPremiumExcel(): parse rows via column mapping, validate empcode against DB employee table, validate premium type via PremiumDefinitionService.validatePremiumName(), check existing records via query
Classify each row: new record -> READY_INSERT, existing same amount -> DUPLICATE_SAME, existing different amount -> WOULD_UPDATE, invalid -> appropriate SKIP
Return PremiumDryRunSummary with full row-by-row detail array
Add employee identity resolution (empcode -> nik, emp_name) for richer preview

reference.pattern: ptkpExcelDryRunService.ts dry-run pattern: parse, validate, classify, return preview with action breakdown
reference.examples: ptkpExcelDryRunService.ts L52-L77 defines ExcelPtkpDryRunAction and ExcelPtkpDryRunRow with action/can_execute/reason pattern. Follow same structure for premium types.

criteria: dryRunPremiumExcel() returns PremiumDryRunSummary with dry_run=true and no database writes
Each row classified into exactly one action category with clear reason string
Duplicate detection correctly identifies existing records by emp_code + period + adjustment_name
Errors from invalid empcodes or unknown premium types appear in errors array with row number context

rationale.chosen_approach: Full dry-run pipeline that parses all rows, validates against DB, and classifies each. No partial writes. User sees complete picture before committing. Follows ptkpExcelDryRunService established pattern.
alternatives_considered: No dry-run, direct import with post-import error report
Dry-run as optional flag, not mandatory
decision_factors: Risk reduction: operators see what will change before it happens
Pattern consistency: ptkpExcelDryRunService already uses this pattern
Data quality: prevents bad data from reaching payroll_manual_adjustments
rationale.tradeoffs: Adds one round-trip to API (dry-run then commit). For large files >1000 rows, DB identity resolution adds latency, but acceptable within 180s timeout.

manual_checks: Upload Excel with mix of new and existing records, verify correct action classification
Upload Excel with invalid empcode, verify SKIP_INVALID_EMPCODE
Upload Excel with duplicate rows for same employee, verify both detected
success_metrics: 100% of rows classified with non-empty action and reason
0 database writes during dry-run (verified via row count unchanged)
Duplicate detection accuracy 100% for existing payroll_manual_adjustments records
